name: TOI-1136
description: Star of 5,770 K, 84.5 parsecs away, with 6 transiting planets.

quotes.title: TOI-1136
quotes.card: TOI-1136 is a G-type main-sequence star 276 light-years away in the constellation of Draco.
quotes.introduction: It is slightly smaller than the Sun and similar in mass and temperature, but is much younger, with an age of about 700 million years.
